concepts.name: Ajolote espacial
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one unlockable funny spacecraft skin concept for TYPELY Orbita, a magical polished 3D typing game for primary-school children. Input reference: use ONLY its high-quality glossy toy-like 3D materials and GAMEPLAY CAMERA, NOT its wing silhouette or palette. Create one genuinely distinctive playful themed spacecraft. Rear overhead three-quarter view, flying UP away from viewer, nose at top and TWO luminous thruster mouths clearly visible at bottom, short bright exhaust to convey forward flight. Opaque jewel canopy, no pilot or visible people. Small nose crystal serves as magical letter-firing emitter. Silhouette clear and attractive at small game-sprite size; premium joyful collectible toy with elegant rounded molded panels, soft specular lighting, believable volume, delightful themed details but not visual clutter. One complete vehicle centered in square image, 10% clear padding all sides. Solid midnight navy backdrop #101735, no checkerboard, no floor, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no labels, no extra vehicles. Design an AXOLOTL SPACESHIP: plump pink pearlescent rounded hull, broad friendly axolotl snout as the top/nose of the ship, tiny smiling face marks on the curved side panels, translucent coral-pink EXTERNAL GILLS as THREE branching soft fin structures on EACH side of the forward hull. These gills are the distinctive silhouette, softly luminous tips and soft rounded petal branches. Oval rosy-lilac opaque cockpit embedded along upper back. Small pale-cyan crystal at nose. Short rounded rear tail stabilizer between two cute compact ivory-pink round engine pods with mint cores. Shimmering pink and peach with mint accents. It is an adorable crafted mechanical spaceship dressed like an axolotl, not an animal wearing a backpack. Render from behind and above, snout toward top, engines bottom. No frightening teeth.
